title: Inference for Fixed Effects Estimators when Panels are Unbalanced
abstract: arXiv:2607.10246v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: We develop the asymptotic theory for two-way fixed effects M-estimators in unbalanced panels, within a framework where both panel dimensions grow large at proportional rates. The selection process may be deterministic, stochastic, or a combination of the two. We require neither a missing-at-random condition nor a selection equation, only a conditional mean restriction on the outcome. The uncorrected estimators are asymptotically normal but not correctly centered due to incidental parameter bias and feedback bias. The latter arises when regressors or the selection indicator respond to past outcomes. We propose debiased estimators that remove both biases without requiring knowledge of which regressors or selection components are predetermined. translated_title: 面板数据不平衡情形下固定效应估计量的统计推断
translated_abstract: 我们在不平衡面板中发展了双向固定效应M-估计量的渐近理论，框架要求面板的两个维度以相称的速率增长。样本选择过程可以是确定性的、随机的，或两者的结合。我们既不需要“随机缺失”条件，也不需要选择方程，仅需要对结果变量的条件均值约束。未经校正的估计量是渐近正态的，但由于伴随参数偏差和反馈偏差，其中心并不正确；后者在回归变量或选择指标对过去结果作出反应时产生。我们提出了去偏差估计量，能够在不需要知道哪些回归变量或选择成分是前定的情况下同时消除这两种偏差。模拟结果显示，这些校正消除了大部分偏差，并使置信区间覆盖率恢复到接近名义水平。通过重新审视一项关于资本流入激增与银行业危机的研究，我们发现该校正（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 本文在不平衡面板框架下建立了双向固定效应M-估计量的渐近理论，识别出伴随参数偏差与反馈偏差两种偏差来源，并提出无需随机缺失假设、无需知道变量前定性的去偏差估计量，从而实现有效的统计推断。
en_tdlr: This paper develops asymptotic theory for two-way fixed effects M-estimators in unbalanced panels, identifies incidental parameter bias and feedback bias, and proposes debiased estimators that require neither missing-at-random assumptions nor knowledge of predetermined variables, enabling valid inference.
